abstractEnglish: We prove that the two-color Ramsey number of the n-dimensional binary cube is at most $`C2^n`$, where C is an absolute constant. This resolves positively the hypercube Ramsey conjecture of Burr and Erdős.
titleEn: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order

details.overview: 稿件研究n维二元超立方体的双色Ramsey数。作者声称证明该Ramsey数至多C2^n，其中C为绝对常数，从而正面解决Burr与Erdős提出的超立方体Ramsey猜想。若成立，这将把超立方体Ramsey数从已知的指数上界改进为线性阶，对Ramsey理论与超立方体组合结构有重要意义。需注意该手稿为AI产生，收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
